shared.name: Fub Clipper
shared.permissions_justification: activeTab/scripting: gesture-gated extraction only; storage: templates/selectors/settings/grants/keys; downloads: explicit .fubcapture.json + capped image staging; contextMenus: clip/highlight entries; nativeMessaging (host local.fub.clipper): paired authenticated capture; notifications: openPopup fallback only. No persistent content scripts, host_permissions empty, provider/image origins optional + grant-gated.

en.detailed_description: Clip articles, selections and highlights to Fub as capture-v1 Markdown (title, source URL, clipped_at). Templates with triggers, bounded filters and logic. Images download only when you check them, capped at 25 MiB with real streamed bytes and explicit origin grants. The optional assistant is OFF by default: nothing leaves the device until you preview the exact request and press Ask; local stays on loopback, remote needs https, a grant and a key. Delivery is native-messaging first to the paired fub-clipper-host (host local.fub.clipper, pairing via fub-cli pair); fub://capture and .fubcapture.json file (fub-cli capture --file) are unauthenticated imports with explicit per-capture app approval.
en.short_description: Clip articles, selections and highlights to Fub. Offline-first, opt-in assistant, paired native delivery.

it.detailed_description: Ritaglia articoli, selezioni ed evidenziazioni in Fub come Markdown capture-v1 (titolo, URL sorgente, clipped_at). Modelli con trigger, filtri limitati e logica vincolata. Le immagini si scaricano solo se le selezioni, con tetto reale di 25 MiB sui byte trasmessi e consenso esplicito per origine. L'assistente opzionale è DISATTIVATO in partenza: nulla lascia il dispositivo finché non vedi l'anteprima esatta e premi Chiedi; il locale resta su loopback, il remoto richiede https, consenso e chiave. Invio prima via native-messaging all'host abbinato fub-clipper-host (host local.fub.clipper, abbinamento con fub-cli pair); fub://capture e file .fubcapture.json (fub-cli capture --file) sono importazioni NON autenticate con approvazione esplicita per ogni acquisizione.
it.short_description: Ritaglia articoli, selezioni ed evidenziazioni in Fub. Offline-first, assistente opt-in, invio nativo abbinato.
